items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And we had some fine players with the band, and a fine pianist and arranger, Lee Wesley Jones, who played with the band.

ctx.x: And we had some fine players with the band, and a fine pianist and arranger, Lee Wesley Jones, who played with the band.

And in the trombone section, we had a trombone player that all I ever knew was Tain! Now, Tain, he couldn't read or write, and he couldn't read music. But if somebody else played it... He was like a computer. If somebody else played... Just like Doc Palmer in Jackson, Mississippi. Tain would listen to somebody else play the lead part, and then from then on he knew it. He played all the leads with the band, in the trombone section, you know.
